name: Fuller House

dates.note: Wikipedia's infobox and text both give 'c.1905' / 'built in about 1905'; the node's exemplar states 1905 flat. Recorded with the circa the source carries.

refs.title: NRHP reference No. 96000433; added to NRHP April 18, 1996; architectural style 'Queen Anne, Colonial Revival' (as the Wikipedia infobox prints it)
refs.note: Read from the infobox, not from the National Register's own database. The infobox's two style words are exactly this node's subject: a Queen Anne body with Colonial Revival trim.

refs.title: Fuller House (Minden, Louisiana) - Wikipedia
refs.note: Its own words: 'While Queen Anne houses of its era would often have Eastlake detailing, this house is unusual for having ornament which is almost all Colonial Revival in style. These elements include a Palladian window, the simple Tuscan columns on the house's wraparound gallery, and denticular molding under the eaves of the main block and on the turret and dormer.'
